description: Install frontend dependencies, verify OpenApiConfig exists and is correct, build and run both backend and frontend, and test end-to-end functionality including login, crops listing, order tracking maps, and the new farmers map endpoint. This verifies all previous fixes work in the integrated system.
steps: Verify c:\25EG505V04\AgriBridge\Farmer-to-Market Management Platform\backend\src\main\java\com\agribridge\config\OpenApiConfig.java exists and contains @OpenAPIDefinition with API info and @SecurityScheme with bearerAuth JWT configuration (already verified during exploration - no changes needed)
Navigate to frontend directory c:\25EG505V04\AgriBridge\Farmer-to-Market Management Platform\frontend and run npm install to install all dependencies from package.json
Verify frontend pages exist: Orders.jsx, Register.jsx, Profile.jsx, TrackGoods.jsx in src/pages (already verified during exploration)
Build backend: run mvn clean install -DskipTests in backend directory to compile and package
Start backend with H2 profile: mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=h2 in backend directory
In separate terminal, start frontend: npm run dev in frontend directory
Open http://localhost:5173 in browser and test: login as farmer (9876543210/Farmer@123), navigate to My Crops page, verify no 500 error (tests FEAT-001 fix), check Track Goods page with map
Test public farmers map endpoint: call GET http://localhost:8080/api/farmer/map in browser or curl, verify JSON response (tests FEAT-003)
Login as buyer (9876543211/Buyer@123), browse crops, place test order, view orders page, check tracking map
Verify Swagger UI at http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html loads with all endpoints including new /api/farmer/map
Document any findings in the findings field for reference
acceptance_criteria: Frontend dependencies installed successfully (node_modules directory created)
Backend builds successfully with BUILD SUCCESS
Backend starts on port 8080 with H2 database without errors
Frontend starts on port 5173 and serves the application
Farmer login works and My Crops page loads without 500 error
Buyer login works and can view crops and orders
GET /api/farmer/map returns 200 OK with verified farmers array
Maps render correctly with Leaflet tiles in TrackGoods page
Swagger UI displays all endpoints including new map endpoint
No CORS errors in browser console
verification: Backend verification: mvn clean install -DskipTests in backend directory must complete with BUILD SUCCESS, then mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=h2 must show 'Started AgriBridgeApplication' and server running on port 8080
Frontend verification: npm install in frontend directory must complete without errors, then npm run dev must show 'VITE ready' and server on port 5173

Integration test: Open http://localhost:5173, login as farmer (9876543210/Farmer@123), click My Crops in navbar, page loads without errors in console, click Track Goods, map component renders with OpenStreetMap tiles visible
API test: curl http://localhost:8080/api/farmer/map or open in browser, must return JSON array with HTTP 200
Swagger test: Open http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html, verify Farmer section shows GET /api/farmer/map endpoint without lock icon (public)
Cross-feature test: All FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003 fixes working together in running application
